technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with overbought conditions and bullish oscillator confluence, but intermediate trend weakness (below 50-MA, below cloud) limits conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: OGN shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings volatility in 3 days—fundamental backdrop is weak across all smart money indicators.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market fear (36/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and stale congressional trades (312+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX at 282.56, FOMC in 2 days) combined with critical earnings binary event in 3 days create extreme risk environment unsuitable for directional positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (AO cross-up, ADX bullish, DC20 new high) with price near support (22.0895) offers technical entry point in fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 3 days combined with crisis VIX, inverted yield curve, FOMC in 2 days, zero fundamental support, and price below all intermediate moving averages create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
